data.title: Rescued US F-15 airman recounts surviving shootdown, evasion in Iran mountains | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: "It was perfectly clear to me that we'd been hit because of the violence of that impact... The best way I've been able to describe that moment was: getting hit by a freight train," said 'Bravo.'
